messages:
Ana: morning micro-stand — quick async check-in:
- did: landed alert suppression PR for model-serving latency and verified canary succeeded
- blocker: small spike on /v1/generate in us-west, looks tied to KV cache churn when sequence lengths jump
- today: repro with runtime team, try a short-term batching policy tweak, will open follow-up ticket
PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/3824

Michael: saw the same spike ~03:12 UTC. dug into gpu-pool metrics — pods healthy, no OOMs. KV hits dropped ~30% during spike window. putting an autoscaler pause branch up now. will post logs in a min.

Sophia: taking paging tonight. i can run synthetic load once michael posts logs to validate SLO after the patch. fyi dashboard shows p95 bump but p99 stayed steady.

Jordan: quick thought — if noise persists we could widen the alert window instead of lowering sensitivity. also can we throttle routing to the canary model group for short bursts?

Michael: agree on window widen. creating branch: infra/disable-autoscale-temporary -> will link when ready. logs: ```
# sample tail
http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/generate",le="0.5"} 243
http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/generate",le="1"} 320
```

Jordan: small config snippet that we might try (temp):
```yaml
- alert: ModelServeHighP90
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.9, rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/generate"}[10m])) > 0.52
  for: 10m
```

deploy-bot: canary deploy redwood/runtime-canary@v2.11 succeeded :rocket: (infra: deploy-474)

Ana: thanks — i'll open ticket #4521 to track follow-ups and assign to Michael. Sophia, Jordan, can you add test cases to the ticket for synthetic validation + routing fallback? :thumbsup:

Sophia: will add synthetic test plan to #4521.

Jordan: adding routing fallback steps. will also ping runtime oncall directly.

Ana: perfect, that'll keep the oncall load low. if anything urgent crops up i’ll page. otherwise we’ll regroup in tomorrow async thread.
